signature.title: ✍️ Action Required: Sign Message
signature.description:
Almost there! Please sign the following message to complete your registration:

**Message to Sign:**
```
{{messageToSign}}
```

Once you've signed, click the button below to submit.

fields.name: How to sign
fields.value:
**Option 1: Foundry `cast` (command line)**
With an encrypted keystore file:
```
cast wallet sign --keystore <file> "<message>"
```
Or enter the key when cast asks for it (the key is not saved in the shell history):
```
cast wallet sign --interactive "<message>"
```

**Option 2: Etherscan and a browser wallet**
1. Open https://etherscan.io/verifiedSignatures and select **Sign Message**.
2. Connect the wallet that holds the address you entered.
3. Paste the message exactly and select **Sign Message**.
4. Copy the **Signature Hash**. Do not select **Publish**.

This works for mainnet and testnet addresses. Sign within 5 minutes. Never share your private key.

whatIsSequencer.title: 📚 What is a Sequencer?
whatIsSequencer.description: **Sequencers are a key part of Aztec's private blockchain.**

fields.name: 🔧 What Do They Do?
fields.value: Sequencers process and order transactions for the network, making sure everything runs smoothly while protecting privacy.

fields.name: 💡 Key Benefits
fields.value:
• Enable private transactions
• Keep the network secure
• Help the network scale

fields.name: 🎯 Requirements
fields.value:
• An active sequencer node
• Correct configuration
• Enough server resources

fields.name: 📖 Learn More
fields.value:
For a deep dive, check out the docs:
[Aztec operator documentation](https://docs.aztec.network/operate/operators)

fields.name: 🆘 Common Issues
fields.value:
• **Registration failed**: Make sure your sequencer is active.
• **Signature error**: Check you're signing with the right wallet.
• **Network issues**: Double-check your node's connection.

fields.name: 🔧 Troubleshooting
fields.value:
1. Check if your sequencer is running.
2. Verify your wallet address format.
3. Make sure you have enough network resources.
